title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Amelia Ross
content:
Goal: capture open questions, quick control mapping, evidence buckets, and immediate remediation actions for SOC2 readiness.

Quick context / assumptions:
- Targeting SOC2 Type 1 for initial pass, then Type 2 in next 9-12 months.
- Scope: hosted API + control plane; exclude customer self-hosted on-prem for now.
- Primary criteria: CC1 (control environment), CC2 (communication), CC3 (risk assessment), CC6 (changes), CC7 (logical and physical access), CC9 (system operations).

Open questions (for security sync):
- Which product routes are in-scope for Hosted API? (billing, model serving, telemetry) -> confirm with Product/Hosted API owners (Priya).
- Do we have a canonical list of encryption-in-transit endpoints and cert rotation policy? (need network team input).
- Backup retention and verified restore procedures for customer metadata/db: who owns and where evidence lives?

Control mapping draft (very rough):
- Access management -> CC7: MFA enforced on SSO, role-based access lists in Okta + periodic attestation -> owner: Identity team (Evan). Evidence: Okta export, attestation spreadsheets.
- Change management -> CC6: PR review policy, code deploy approvals, release calendar -> owner: Release Eng. Evidence: GitHub PRs, release playbooks, post-deploy runbooks.
- Logging & monitoring -> CC9: centralized logs (Datadog), alerting runbooks, on-call rota -> owner: SRE. Evidence: dashboard snapshots, alert history.
- Vendor management -> CC3: vendor inventory + contracts with security clauses -> owner: Legal/Security. Evidence: vendor registry CSV, SOC reports from vendors.

Evidence buckets (where to look):
- Identity provider (Okta) reports, SSO configs.
- GitHub org settings, branch protection rules, PR review history.
- CI/CD pipeline logs, deployment timestamps.
- Datadog dashboards and alert history (7-90 days).
- Backup snapshots and restore verification notes.
- Training attestations and new-hire security checklist completion.

Immediate gaps I remember:
- No documented cert rotate schedule for internal service-to-service TLS. (owner: Infra)
- Incomplete attestation cadence for some service owners (old list) - need to run a fresh attestation.
- Vendor inventory missing a few subcontractors (SaaS analytics, observability).

Proposed immediate actions (next 30 days):
1) Run quick evidence discovery sprint: ask each owner for 1-2 representative artifacts. (owners: Evan, Priya, SRE lead, Release Eng)
2) Create a simple evidence index doc (spreadsheet) mapping control -> artifact link -> owner -> status. (I can spin up a template)
3) Schedule a 45-minute SOC2 kickoff with Product/Hosted API/Infra/SRE/Legal next week to confirm scope and owners.
4) Triage cert rotation and backup restore as high priority tickets.

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep records of adhoc requests to auditors (save emails).
- For Type 2 timeline, we'll need continuous evidence retention for 6 months+; discuss retention with infra.
- Consider automating attestation collection via Slack form + Google Sheet as short-term fix.

Meeting snippets (2024-02-28 sync):
- Legal: prefer including vendor SOC reports where available; will request missing ones.
- SRE: can provide Datadog clips and alert runbook, but retention for logs might need to be extended (cost question).
- Release Eng: branch protection is mostly in place, need to capture exceptions (legacy services).

TODOs (assigned):
- Amelia: create evidence index template + invite list for kickoff (due 2024-03-04).
- Evan: export Okta org report + list of service accounts (due 2024-03-05).
- Samira: compile vendor registry and flag missing SOC reports (due 2024-03-08).

Quick brainstorm: automated evidence helpers
- Cron job to export cert expiry list into Google Sheet weekly.
- GitHub action that tags PRs that are security-impacting for easier evidence collection.

End of scratchpad. Will iterate after kickoff and fill in evidence index.
